name: Iryna Pavlenko
headline: Platform and DevOps Engineer
summary: Platform and DevOps engineer with a strong focus on reliable delivery, observability, and secure infrastructure. Experienced in building and operating cloud environments, improving deployment flow, and supporting teams with practical automation. Known for steady execution across microservices, Kubernetes, and monitoring-heavy environments.

roles.title: Junior Software Engineer
bullets: Built and supported microservices for internal services, and added Prometheus checks to catch service degradation earlier.
Improved incident triage by tuning Prometheus alerts and reducing noise during release windows by 28%.
Worked with the engineering team to stabilize deployments and keep the backend maintainable during rapid change.

roles.title: DevOps Engineer
bullets: Automated cloud provisioning across AWS and Azure with Bash and Git, cutting environment setup time by 40%.
Managed Kubernetes clusters and Prometheus dashboards to improve service visibility and reduce recurring outages.
Standardized release steps with Git and Bash so the team could ship changes with fewer manual handoffs.
Partnered with developers to keep cloud infrastructure consistent across production and staging.

roles.title: Platform Engineer
bullets: Built platform services in Azure and Kubernetes, using Docker and Python to support internal product teams.
Introduced GitHub Actions workflows for MLOps delivery and tightened release traceability across environments.
Strengthened secret handling with Cryptography and Prometheus-based checks, lowering security review findings by 35%.
Improved container image handling with Docker and Kubernetes so teams could roll out changes more predictably.

roles.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
bullets: Designed secure automation with Ansible, Terraform, and Linux to support repeatable infrastructure changes across Azure and Kubernetes.
Developed operational tooling in Go and Python, and used Grafana with Prometheus to shorten alert investigation time by 32%.
Hardened delivery workflows with GitHub Actions, Docker, and Helm while improving governance through OWASP, Threat modeling, SIEM, and Cryptography.
